Vilmorin-Andrieux et Cie (Paris) trade catalogues, acquired as a dated SERIES
so that the appearance of each tomato variety can be dated in the French trade.
Retrieved 2026-08-30 from the Internet Archive. All public domain.

NOTE ON TEXT: all eight catalogue PDFs are IMAGE-ONLY -- scripts/extract_text.py
correctly reports "NO TEXT LAYER" for every one rather than writing empty files.
The searchable text for each is the accompanying *.ocr.txt (the Internet
Archive _djvu.txt OCR layer), which is what the per-year variety extraction in
REPORT.md section 10 was derived from. Term-search the .ocr.txt files, not the PDFs.
